integrity.evidence: Analytic derivative-quadratic proof plus reproducible standard-library checker; no empirical validation or independent certification.

scientific_limitations: Idealized deterministic, additive, instantaneous two-pulse model with a fixed Erlang-3 routing response.
Counts strict local maxima, not relative heights, observational resolvability, or real-catchment attribution.
General mixture theory and incomplete literature coverage leave historical priority provisional.
title: Reentrant double peaks in a two-pulse three-reservoir hydrograph
